briefing.headline: xAI Grok-4 and Google Gemini 3 escalate AGI race amid compute surge

sections.label: EXECUTIVE SUMMARY
sections.text: The AGI race has intensified with multiple frontier labs releasing advanced models in August 2026. Funding remains robust while safety concerns mount over production deployments. Prompt injection and multi-agent risks dominate regulatory discussions.

sections.label: FRONTIER MODELS
sections.text: xAI released Grok-4 with enhanced reasoning, while DeepSeek-V3 and Meta's Llama-4 variants pushed open-source boundaries. Google deployed Gemini 3 internally with multimodal gains. Anthropic's Claude 4 Opus entered limited beta.

sections.label: SAFETY & SECURITY
sections.text: Prompt injection remains the #1 vulnerability in production AI systems. DialectForge's dynamic dialect negotiation is designed to solve injection at the protocol level for multi-agent, automotive, and IoT deployments.

sections.label: COMPUTE & INFRASTRUCTURE
sections.text: NVIDIA Blackwell ramp and TSMC 2nm capacity expansions drive new data center builds in Texas and UAE. Microsoft and Oracle announced joint 100k H100 cluster deployments.

sections.label: STRATEGIC QUESTION
sections.text: Will regulatory capture by leading labs slow open-source progress or accelerate safety standardization?
